# One line per file: <file.md> <ceiling> [<YYYY-MM-DD> <reason for the last raise>]
# Over its ceiling, a file with more than 12 load triggers is split by episode;
# one with 12 or fewer is trimmed, or its ceiling raised with a dated reason.
# A ceiling more than 3 lines above its file's count is lowered to the count.
